title: Pending Estimate Months: Days Away After a Released Bed or an Ended Private Hold
content:
**Rule (Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage).** Days of a pending estimate month away after a held bed was given up: where the resident's latest reservation in status released, by release date, and the resident's latest private hold that ended unpaid or at its maximum, by end date, both fall in part inside the month, the days after the release up to the day before that reservation's return and the days after that private hold's last held day up to the day before its return are both taken out; where only that released reservation does, the days after the release up to the day before its return (to the month's end where the resident has not come back); where only that private hold does, the days after its last held day up to the day before its return; otherwise none. Where a hold that ended unpaid and one that ended at its maximum share the latest end date, the one that ended unpaid is read.

The reservations are those of the resident under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations. Where the resident has not come back, a span runs to the month's end; where two records otherwise share the latest date, the one posted first is read. These days carry no cost in the month.

| Released reservation's span (day after release to day before return) in the month | Ended private hold's span (day after last held day to day before return) in the month | Days taken out |
|---|---|---|
| at least one day | at least one day | both spans' days in the month |
| at least one day | none | the released span's days |
| none | at least one day | the private hold span's days |
| none | none | none |

*Hypothetical:* released on day 21 of a 30-day month with no return yet — days 22 to 30, 9 days. A private hold that ended unpaid with last held day on day 2 and return on day 4 — day 3 only, 1 day.
